title.zh-CN: 反复发热与咯血 · 29岁男性

answer.zh-CN: 近1周咳嗽、咳痰、咯血，还喘、心慌，夜间不能平卧。
answer.en: For one week there has been cough, sputum, haemoptysis, breathlessness, palpitations and inability to lie flat at night.

question.zh-CN: 此前发生过什么神经系统事件？

answer.zh-CN: 起病时曾烦躁和说胡话，查出脑出血和动脉瘤，做了栓塞术，之后仍反复发热。
answer.en: Early in the illness there was agitation and delirium. Brain haemorrhage and an aneurysm were found and embolised, but fever continued.

answer.en: About a year earlier trauma required over four months in hospital and five operations, including abdominal exploration and mesenteric and retroperitoneal repairs.

text.zh-CN: 二尖瓣前叶有两处赘生物，前叶脱垂、重度关闭不全，考虑部分小腱索断裂；左心房和左心室增大。

name.zh-CN: 调阅脑部影像和治疗记录

zh-CN: 调阅脑部影像和治疗记录

text.zh-CN: 早期CT/CTA发现脑出血伴颅内动脉瘤，后行左大脑中动脉瘤栓塞。当前完整神经影像未给出；不能仅凭本记录确定动脉瘤病因。
text.en: Early CT/CTA found intracranial haemorrhage with an aneurysm, followed by left middle cerebral artery aneurysm embolisation. Complete current neuroimaging is unavailable and aneurysm causation cannot be established from this record.

source.zh-CN: 原报告正文的去标识化摘要；对话措辞为教学改写。
source.en: De-identified summary of the source report; dialogue wording is an educational adaptation.

text.zh-CN: 患者接受赘生物清除及二尖瓣生物瓣置换。瓣膜病理见炎性坏死、纤维素性渗出、钙化及肉芽组织，支持感染性心内膜炎。具体抗菌方案和长期随访未记录。
text.en: Vegetations were removed and the mitral valve replaced with a bioprosthesis. Pathology showed inflammatory necrosis, fibrinous exudate, calcification and granulation tissue, supporting infective endocarditis. The antimicrobial regimen and long-term follow-up are not reported.

text.zh-CN: 屎肠球菌感染性心内膜炎伴严重二尖瓣损害
text.en: Enterococcus faecium infective endocarditis with severe mitral valve damage

feedback.zh-CN: 连续阳性血培养和瓣膜赘生物互相支持，肺部症状不能覆盖这些证据。
feedback.en: Repeated positive cultures and valve vegetations are concordant; pulmonary symptoms do not explain these findings.

text.zh-CN: 仅右肺感染可解释全部病情
text.en: A right-sided lung infection explains the whole illness

feedback.zh-CN: 连续阳性血培养和瓣膜赘生物互相支持，肺部症状不能覆盖这些证据。

knowledge.zh-CN: 这是历史病例教学。先核对当前阶段原始证据，再讨论鉴别诊断及安全计划；原报告处置不自动成为今天的推荐。
knowledge.en: This is a historical teaching case. Review evidence for the current phase before discussing differential diagnosis and a safe plan; reported care is not automatically a recommendation for current practice.

conclusion.zh-CN: 两次屎肠球菌培养及瓣膜证据支持感染性心内膜炎；感染源和脑动脉瘤的因果归属仍有限。
conclusion.en: Two E. faecium cultures and valve findings support infective endocarditis; the infection source and aneurysm causation remain uncertain.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 听诊使持续发热的评估重新聚焦于心脏。
keyReasoning.en: Auscultation redirected the persistent-fever assessment toward the heart.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 既往正常超声不能排除后来出现的感染性心内膜炎。
keyReasoning.en: Earlier normal echocardiograms do not exclude subsequently acquired endocarditis.

boundaries.zh-CN: 这是单例观察，不能证明某种治疗的独立疗效或普遍适用性。历史处置仅记录事实；安全决策为教学设计。
boundaries.en: This single observation cannot establish the independent efficacy or general applicability of a treatment. Historical care is recorded as fact; safety decisions are educational design.
